Services That Keep Your Freight Moving.

Cross-Dock

Trailer to trailer with little or no storage in between. We work damaged trailers, driver-hour limits, and distribution disconnects. We're the dock in the middle, so your freight keeps moving.

Restack & Rework

Shifted pallets, leaning loads, refused freight at Target or Walmart. We pull the load, rework the pallets, and send it back on the trailer safe to transport. Materials, labor, and documentation all included on the quote upfront.

Short-Term Storage

A few nights to a few months. Pallet-in, pallet-out billing with daily storage rates. Event staging, trade show overflow, multi-order holds, and project receiving. Scalable to whatever volume you need.

Transload

Transfer freight between vehicles and configurations. Container to trailer. Full truck to lift-gate. Loose cargo built onto pallets ready to ship. Whatever shape and size your freight needs to reach its next scheduled stop.

Final Mile

When the original carrier can’t finish the job locally, we run it on a Move Solutions truck. Our fleet is DFW-based and knows the delivery landscape. One handoff, one trip, one invoice back to the broker.

Emergency Unload

Trailer breaches, refused loads, damaged goods consolidation, and freight disposal. One call to dispatch gets your load off the trailer and onto our dock so your driver can get back on the road fast.

How We Work With You.

01

Dispatch

Even for emergency service, we need a call to dispatch before you arrive. We confirm the dock, the crew, and your timing.

02

Arrive

Driver pulls into our gated yard at the confirmed window. Trailer backs to the dock. Our crew takes it from there.

03

Solve

Cross-dock, restack, store, transload, or hold. We work the freight until it is cleared to move again, documented and ready for the next leg of its journey.

04

Reload

Back on the trailer. Driver back on the road. Documentation sent to broker and shipper same day.

Turnaround varies by freight volume, condition, and available labor. A quick cross-dock can be minutes. A full floor-loaded 53′ restack can take hours. We give you a realistic window on the dispatch call.

Quick Answers.

What are your operating hours?
Our warehouse is staffed around the clock Monday through Friday, with at least one forklift operator on the floor at all times. Saturday coverage is typical through 7 PM and Sunday coverage runs 8 AM to noon for housekeeping and light tasks. Weekend scheduling is confirmed the night before. Any work outside these windows is arranged through dispatch.
Do I need to call before arriving?
Yes. Even for emergency service, we need a call to dispatch before you arrive so we can confirm the dock, the window, and the labor you’ll need. This also helps us tell you upfront whether we can honor your target delivery window.
How quickly can you accept a load?
Most inbound freight can be scheduled the same day you call. For urgent cross-docks during business hours, we often take trailers within the same shift. For large restacks or multi-trailer events, we may need a few hours of lead time to pull the right crew together.
What do you charge?
Pricing is handled through dispatch or your broker on a per-job basis. Most work is priced on pallets in, pallets out, plus labor and materials. After-hours, weekend, and holiday work is priced accordingly.
Do you work with brokers directly?
Yes. Brokers drive the majority of our cross-dock work. We're on the preferred provider lists at OLIMP and ILM and respond to broker bids directly. If you’re a broker, dispatch is the single phone number you need; we’ll quote the job and confirm the dock in one call.
What size shipments can you handle?
A single pallet to a full truckload. We regularly take anything from a handful of parcels through FedEx and UPS up to multi-trailer freight events. If it fits in a 53′ trailer, we can usually find a dock for it.
What can’t you handle?
We are a dry warehouse and not a food-grade facility. Refrigerated loads are time-sensitive and limited to cross-docks that move truck-to-truck with no staging. Alcohol work is limited to emergency rework from a disrupted delivery; we cannot be part of your distribution chain. All specialty freight requires coordination and approval through dispatch before arrival.
How do you protect my freight?
Fenced, gated yard with camera-monitored access. Your freight stays where you left it, and dispatch is reachable at any hour if something comes up.
What documentation do I get?
Standard BOL updates and signed delivery confirmations on everything we handle. For restacks and reworks, we document pallet counts, condition, and damaged units. For brokers and shippers who want them, inbound and outbound photos are available on request.
Where are you located?
Our Irving facility sits in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex at 2201 Chemsearch Blvd, within easy reach of the major freight corridors. Service radius extends out to Waco to the south, with Office Moving Alliance partners handling freight beyond that. Call dispatch for gate instructions.
